title: Tangy Jamaican Galette Crust Cracker Crumble
description: A twist on traditional galette crust, combining tangy Jamaican flavors with crunchy cracker crumbs.
instructions: In a medium bowl, mix together graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, Jamaican spice blend, baking powder, and salt until well combined.
Press the crumb mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch (23cm) tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, mix together sugar and egg until well combined.
Pour the sugar-egg mixture over the crumb crust.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Allow the crust to cool completely before serving.
